# Markbel

> Markbel is an open-source, offline-first bookmark manager and rich media archiver built with React 19, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1 SQLite, and Dexie.js IndexedDB.

## Core Capabilities
- **Offline-First Storage**: Instant local read/write execution using Dexie.js IndexedDB with zero mandatory login.
- **Bi-Directional Delta Sync**: Append-only change log synchronization on Cloudflare D1 SQLite with Last-Write-Wins (LWW) conflict resolution.
- **Rich Media Extraction**: Edge-based oEmbed metadata scraper supporting YouTube Shorts, YouTube Videos, TikTok, and Twitter/X.
- **Mobile Dual-View UI**: Fast switching between a responsive 2-column mobile card grid and a compact 56px list row layout.
- **PWA Web Share Target**: Native share sheet handler (`/share`) to capture URLs directly from mobile operating systems.
- **Resilient Authentication**: Non-destructive token caching, offline session survival, and 6-digit email password reset flow.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Vite 6, Lucide React, Framer Motion
- **Local Storage Engine**: Dexie.js 4 (IndexedDB with live reactive queries)
- **Edge Backend**: Cloudflare Workers, Hono, WebCrypto (PBKDF2 / HMAC-SHA256 JWT)
- **Cloud Database**: Cloudflare D1 (Serverless SQLite)
- **PWA & Caching**: Vite Plugin PWA, Workbox

## Key Project Directories
- `src/App.tsx`: Main application router and state initializer
- `src/views/BookmarksPage.tsx`: Primary bookmark feed, dual view grid/list layout, filtering, and search
- `src/views/ShareTargetPage.tsx`: PWA Web Share Target receiver and processor
- `src/db/db.ts`: Dexie.js database schema and table definitions
- `src/db/SyncManager.ts`: Client synchronization engine and outbox scheduler
- `src/sync/SyncLWW.ts`: Last-Write-Wins conflict resolution implementation
- `src/sync/GuestMigration.ts`: Guest-to-authenticated account bookmark transfer
- `worker/src/index.ts`: Cloudflare Workers edge router and API endpoints
- `worker/schema.sql`: Authoritative Cloudflare D1 SQLite schema

## Primary API Endpoints
- `GET /api/health` - Healthcheck endpoint
- `POST /api/auth/register` - User account registration
- `POST /api/auth/login` - User login and JWT issuance
- `POST /api/auth/forgot-password` - Request 6-digit password reset verification code
- `POST /api/auth/reset-password` - Verify code and reset account password
- `GET /api/sync/pull?since={sequence}` - Delta pull mutations occurring after sequence cursor
- `POST /api/sync/push` - Delta push batched local outbox mutations
- `GET /api/metadata?url={url}` - Extract metadata and oEmbed assets for arbitrary URL

## Synchronization Protocol Summary
1. **Push**: Client sends queued mutations from IndexedDB outbox to `POST /api/sync/push`. The server records entities into D1 SQLite and writes rows to `sync_changes` with monotonic sequence IDs.
2. **Pull**: Client requests `GET /api/sync/pull?since={lastSequence}` to retrieve mutations logged after `lastSequence`.
3. **Reconciliation**: Client compares remote `updatedAt` with local record timestamps, applying Last-Write-Wins rules.
